assertion: A regular-only font demonstrates weight/style permissions independently. none disables synthesis, and weight does not allow a synthetic italic.

browser.reason: Reviewed Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, native output and enlarged differences. Permission behavior agrees: none stays upright and regular, weight-only stays upright, style-only slants. Browsers use different synthetic emboldening strengths (WebKit visibly heavier). Allow font-edge rasterization and UA-defined synthetic weight differences; unit tests separately assert permissions, real-face selection and expanded contours with counters.
